package_assessment.rationale: The verifier failures are all `OSError: [Errno 98] Address already in use` on port 8765 during pytest fixture setup. This is caused by the agent's own verification workflow: it started a local `python3 -m http.server 8765` to run a jsdom smoke test and, although it attempted `pkill -f 'http.server 8765'`, the port was evidently still bound when the verifier ran. All content tests errored at fixture setup, so no substantive skill-controllable defect in bubble chart, table, tooltip, legend, clustering, or formatting behavior can be evidenced from the verifier output. The agent's own jsdom probe indicated 50 bubbles, 50 labels, 50 rows, 5 legend items, 5 unique colors, and no JS errors, which is inconsistent with any observed skill deficiency. The failure mechanism is an executor/agent workflow artifact (leaving a background HTTP server bound to a well-known port used by the verifier), not a defect in the reusable d3-visualization skill guidance. Per instructions, infrastructure/executor failures are not to be labeled as skill defects.
